fields.source: acquisition frame identity and host receipt; no image or dense-flow payload
fields.feedback_result: canonical Protobuf JSON FeedbackResult; int64/uint64 decimal strings, source/reset/pose lineage
fields.stage_evidence: registered decoded objects; flow-proxy intermediate evidence remains px/s and rad/s

SESSION_CONFIG.json.projector_brightness.scope: latest admitted adjustment in this controller lifetime; all discovered USB interfaces, not display assignments
SESSION_CONFIG.json.projector_brightness.unknown: no observed adjustment; requested current and readbacks absent

fields.requested_ma: requested equal RGB LED current in mA; not measured luminance
fields.completed_monotonic_ns: host monotonic ns at operator outcome observation
fields.completed_utc: UTC observation time at operator outcome
fields.native_cleanup_confirmed: exact process/job/pipe and supervisor release; not USB state or RGB current proof
fields.sdk_result: null if no complete validated helper result; otherwise requested_ma, discovered_interfaces, success and interfaces
fields.sdk_result.interfaces: ordered index/name/id, readback_ma RGB or null, clamped bool or null, confirmed, release_confirmed, error; every discovered interface accounted
fields.diagnostics: human SDK diagnostics tail, at most6000 characters
fields.error: overall failure/uncertainty detail; empty on success

SESSION_CONFIG.json.projector_brightness.clamp: request above1023 with all RGB readbacks1023 is explicitly clamped, not requested=applied
SESSION_CONFIG.json.projector_brightness.freshness: historical observation; external TI tools or power changes are not monitored
